name: Gau Rakshak
tagline: AI-Based Early Mastitis Risk Forecasting System for Dairy Cows
purpose: Gau Rakshak is an offline edge-AI system developed for dairy cows to forecast mastitis risk at an early stage, helping farmers take timely action before severe infection develops.
safety_policy: Gau Rakshak is an early warning and risk forecasting system, NOT a confirmed medical diagnosis tool. It does not prescribe medicine or dosage. For high-risk alerts, a qualified veterinarian must examine the cow.

components.raspberry_pi_4: Serves as the central offline edge processing hub, executing local AI models, knowledge queries, and hardware interfacing.
components.thermal_camera: Captures infrared thermal images of the udder to detect subtle localized temperature increases indicative of early inflammation.
components.rfid: Reads cow identification RFID tags to map health metrics and sensor readings to individual cows in the herd.
components.as7343: 11-channel spectral sensor used for optical spectral sensing of milk samples. Note: It is part of multi-sensor data fusion and is NOT a standalone diagnostic device.
components.dht11: Measures ambient environmental temperature and relative humidity inside the shed. Note: It is strictly an environmental sensor and is NOT used to measure milk temperature.
components.esp32: Acts as a low-power wireless sensor node collecting environmental and telemetry data.
components.solar_power: Provides sustainable, off-grid power supply for continuous operation in rural dairy farms.
components.oled: Provides local real-time status and alert displays directly on the hardware enclosure.
